method: Fresh bin/ut processes on a shared, loaded workstation; default arena, no --lowmem. Build time excluded. ninja -j 1 bin/ut before validation. No build/ci.sh or bin/arena runs for this change. Final samples alternate worker counts in order 1,32,32,1,1,32. Final binary has no temporary instrumentation. Other machine load was not controlled.
changes: Thread-local settled module, call-context, completed-mangle and mangled-name snapshots; cold reads retain the frontend lock; reset/shutdown advances an invalidation epoch.
Replace 200000-iteration static-array value test with short repeated values and a >32-bit sum; add a direct temporary-storage reuse witness.
Array operation lengths follow each element type's 16-byte vector width, keeping zero, scalar, boundary, vector and tail cases for all existing types/operators.
Initial frame stack commit reduced from 1 MiB to 4 KiB; stable 1 GiB reservation and doubling unchanged.
Test builds default to one additional GC marking thread; command-line GC overrides remain available.

metadata_lock_probe.note: Temporary probes count outermost compiler lock acquisitions only; summed waits overlap across threads. Single samples, not elapsed-time proof. Cold mangling moves into the query interval in the final variant.
metadata_lock_probe.behavior: Warm metadata progress test failed with a 5-second timeout before caching; passes after caching while another thread holds the frontend lock.

slot_reuse_fault.mutation: Interpreter temporary slot lookup always creates a new slot instead of reusing the variable's slot. Restored after measurement.

vector_load_fault.mutation: 16-byte vector load zeroes the result instead of copying the source. Restored after measurement.

test_roi.limits: Fault injection checks the specified defects; it does not prove equivalence for every possible defect. The new storage-identity witness was attempted across the full backend matrix; CTFE lacks native temporary slots and failed, so it has the same Omit as the existing adjacent slot-reuse test. The value witness retains all backends.

frame_capacity_rationale: The 1 MiB constant was inherited from fixed-capacity stacks (0e009c84, f755ec27); stable-address growth (136101f0) retained it. GC scans committed capacity, so small frames paid for unused space. Existing tiny-capacity growth, alignment, concurrent collection, thread-state, VM and finalizer checks passed with the smaller default.
remaining_problem: Parallel scaling remains poor. These changes do not solve it. Serial preparation, cold frontend work under the shared compiler lock, process-wide GC pauses and coarse runner batches remain. Final serial timings vary significantly with workstation load.

profile_after.note: NativeData.reserve is not supported as the next major CPU target by this sample. Normal debug bin/ut still records arena stack words only needed by the separate arena report; changing this would need preserving validation startup behavior. Profiling measures running CPU, not mutex sleep time.
